info.title: ZZZ Wallpaper Companion API
info.description: Contract baseline for Companion fix/game-station-stability-ui at 2bdc079. Existing protocol remains 2–2. This describes wire behavior; handlers retain validation. JSON errors use {error}; middleware rejection and mux failures can be plain text. GET routes also accept HEAD via Go ServeMux; OPTIONS is handled by existing CORS middleware. Read operations can populate caches. Streaming/media operations are documentation-only in the explorer.

servers.description: Current local serving origin and port

get.description: Dependency readiness is distinct from connectivity; ready follows FFmpeg availability. Capability flags describe implemented features.

post.description: Renews a per-session 20-second lease. keepStreamAlive=false cancels an active relay for this session only. Protocol ranges must overlap 2–2; no wire protocol increment.
Renews a per-session 20-second lease. keepStreamAlive=false cancels an active relay for this session only. Protocol ranges must overlap 2–2; no wire protocol increment.

Looks up normalized track metadata; disk/memory cache and upstream provider access. A new uncached lookup cancels the previous service lookup. Request decoding errors are 400; invalid normalized metadata and upstream errors are 502. Cancellation can end without a JSON body.

get.description: Latest sample collected once per second. GPU is omitted when unavailable. Percentage usage and byte counters.
Read saved dates. A corrupt file is preserved and returns 500.

post.description: Replace the complete document with optimistic revision checking. Success increments revision. Rejects trailing JSON. Never automatically retry writes.

get.description: Read saved country/region; corrupt settings are preserved.

post.description: Replace selection after country validation; preserve previous settings on persistence failure. Reject trailing JSON; do not retry automatically.

get.description: Country discovery cached for 7 days. Failure can return 200 with error text and Taiwan/China fallback. Failed refresh attempts are throttled for 15 minutes.
Derive regions from public holidays. TW/CN return an empty array. Upstream calls use 12-second timeouts.

Uses saved selection. Cache keyed by country/year, filtered by selected region. Last-good data survives failed refreshes; 200 may contain available=false and error. Unselected country returns empty records, available=true.

PNG proxy for visible tiles. z 0–19; x/y less than 2^z. Four upstream slots; provider timeout 15 seconds. Persistent provider cache policy (fallback 7 days), conditional revalidation and one-hour minimum provider-block backoff. Do not load as JSON.

Cache-Control.description: private, max-age derived from remaining expiry

get.description: 50-second resolution context. Returns provider URLs and expiry metadata. hlsCompat=1 selects HLS compatibility mode. yt-dlp installation returns 503 with Retry-After: 15.
50-second context; yt-dlp failure (including unavailable install) is currently 502.

HTTPS googlevideo.com/subdomain URLs only; no credentials or explicit port. Validates redirects. Forwards Range and upstream status, Accept-Ranges, Content-Range. Rewrites manifest URLs using configured port; manifests limited to 2 MiB, other resources copied as streams. Resolver HTTP timeout 2 minutes.

200.description: Manifest or media resource; upstream Content-Type preserved for non-manifests.

default.description: Other upstream status and body forwarded for manifests/media; media type follows upstream.

get.description: Live WebM relay requires an active keepStreamAlive=true heartbeat session. Lease checked each second; replacement cancels previous relay for the same session. No generic buffered request timeout or server write timeout. Media element owns consumption.
Saved settings, including configured port. Listener moves only on restart.

post.description: Replace settings; changing startup setting modifies Windows startup registration. Port change requires restart. A config validation or persistence error currently returns 400; startup registration failure returns 500.

get.description: Lists cartridges and computes 14-slot shelf. Despite GET, loose ROMs and associated saves are moved into cartridge folders. Explicit explorer action required.

post.description: Raw supported ROM upload, 1 byte–64 MiB; query name determines extension. Deduplicates by SHA1 (200 existing, 201 new).

get.description: rom/save/state/label reads; missing file is 404. ServeContent handles Range and modification conditions; download=1 adds attachment filename. Literal details route takes precedence. Cart ID must be a nonhidden folder basename.

200.description: File up to 64 MiB; label is image/png, others octet-stream.

416.description: Range rejected by ServeContent; text response.

post.description: Only save/state writable; 1 byte–8 MiB, atomic replacement. Optional X-Cart-Rev rejects stale saves; omitted header remains compatible. Previous save .bak retained; states rotate up to three backups when at least 10 minutes old. Identical data returns 204.

get.description: Metadata, save file details (nullable when absent) and available numbered state backups. Computes/persists ROM hash when missing.

post.description: reset/import/restore shelve replaced files in backups and bump revision (200). remove moves cartridge to roms/.removed, clears matching selection (204). shelf controls explicit shelf preference (204, 409 if 14 slots full). No automatic write retry.

requestBody.description: Required only for import: raw 1 byte–8 MiB save.

get.description: In-memory selection; seq resets on restart.

post.description: Select existing cart or clear with empty ID; increments seq, fresh=false. May migrate loose ROMs while finding a cart.

get.description: SSE data events containing input.Snapshot JSON; comment keep-alive every 15 seconds. Hardware polls only with subscribers. Last disconnect resets input capture. EventSource handles reconnect; do not buffer as JSON.

200.description: SSE: data: {snapshot} followed by blank line; : keep-alive comments.

post.description: Changes native keyboard/controller capture while input subscribers exist; resets when final subscriber leaves. Capture desktop/key/always or empty (desktop default).

leaseUntil.description: Unix milliseconds; lease expires 20 seconds after heartbeat.

lyrics.Request.description: Omitted Go fields take zero values. Invalid normalized metadata is currently reported as 502, not 400.

id.description: Unique in document; maximum 100 UTF-8 bytes.

dates.Document.description: Revision defaults to 0 when omitted. Writes must match current revision; success increments it. Events must be a non-null array.

holidays.Settings.description: Empty country and subdivision disable selection. Region must belong to country. TW/CN accept national selection only. Omitted fields default to empty strings.

settings.Document.description: Omitted booleans become false on POST. No merge with saved settings.

expiresAt.description: Unix seconds, derived from provider URL expire query.

games.SelectRequest.description: Empty/omitted id clears selection. Unknown JSON fields are accepted.
